skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Increases own [Instant DMG Accuracy] by 50%. Deals 3000% ATK DMG to enemies in a column with 2 consecutive strikes and triggers [Specialized Breakthrough] 1 time. [Specialized Breakthrough]: Instantly removes [DMG Ignoration] and increases own ATK% until the end of this attack.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Increases own [Instant DMG Accuracy] by 65%. Deals 4000% ATK DMG to enemies in a column with 2 consecutive strikes and triggers [Specialized Breakthrough] 2 times. [Specialized Breakthrough]: Instantly removes [DMG Ignoration] and increases own ATK by 40% until the end of this attack.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Gains 60% [Non-Crit DMG Free]. When any character acts, removes [Stun], [Specialized Stun], or [Silence] from 1 ally. [Non-Crit DMG Free]: Reduces all types of DMG and cannot coexist with [Agility].

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Gains 70% [Non-Crit DMG Free]. When any character acts, removes [Stun], [Specialized Stun], or [Silence] from 2 allies. [Non-Crit DMG Free]: Reduces all types of DMG and cannot coexist with [Agility].

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Gains 80% [Non-Crit DMG Free]. When any character acts, removes [Stun], [Specialized Stun], or [Silence] from 3 allies. [Non-Crit DMG Free]: Reduces all types of DMG and cannot coexist with [Agility].

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: At the beginning of battle, summons 10 Mosquitoes to assist in battle. Each Mosquito inherits 800% of Mosquito Girl’s base ATK. The Mosquito Swarm shares 80% of all types of DMG received by the entire team, except Emblem DMG. The Mosquito Swarm reduces the shared DMG by 80% and can be removed.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: At the beginning of battle, summons 10 Mosquitoes to assist in battle. Each Mosquito inherits 1000% of Mosquito Girl’s base ATK. The Mosquito Swarm shares 80% of all types of DMG received by the entire team, except Emblem DMG. The Mosquito Swarm reduces the shared DMG by 80% and can be removed. The entire team gains 40% [Detonation DMG Immunity] and 40% [DoT DMG Immunity].

effects.desc: Shield ignores damage from certain attacks. Must be penetrated by Breakthrough or Charge/True DMG.
PvP tier of Stun — harder to resist or resolve.
The stun-type control effect prevents the target from taking action during the duration.
The target cannot use his ultimate. Counts as a control effect.
Reduced damage taken from non-critical attacks.
